verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents no first-party way to set up recurring or triggered automations that run on their own in the background. The closest evidence is batch APIs with webhooks, an MCP server, and integrations with n8n, Make and Zapier. These are developer building blocks or third-party automation platforms, so the background automation itself would live outside HeyGen. The Video Agent 'handles the rest' only within a single one-off generation, not as a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
